inspired_by: The Monkey and the Crocodile, from the Panchatantra
learning: Staying calm and thinking when you are in trouble, and never tricking a friend

characters.name: Chiku
characters.who: a cheerful monkey with a curly tail who lives in a jamun tree

characters.name: Magar
characters.who: a crocodile with a big grin and a bigger appetite

pages.text: That night, the old Panchatantra book glowed again. Mehar opened it, and whoosh! She tumbled into a tall jamun tree, right next to a monkey with a curly tail.
"Hello! I'm Chiku," said the monkey. "These are the sweetest jamuns in the whole jungle. Try one!" Mehar took a big bite. Yum! Now her lips were purple.
Below the tree, a crocodile called Magar floated in the river. Chiku threw him jamuns: plop, plop, PLOP! "Thank you, best friend!" grinned Magar, with a lot of very pointy teeth.
"Come to my island for dinner!" said Magar. "Hop on my back." Chiku clapped. But Mehar noticed something: Magar's eyes kept sliding away, and he would not look at them.
Splish, splosh! In the very middle of the river, Magar stopped. "Sorry," he said. "My wife wants a monkey's heart for dinner. She says yours must be extra sweet!"
Chiku shook like a leaf. They couldn't swim, and the shore was far away. Mehar's heart went thump, thump. But she didn't cry. She took a deep breath... and thought. (Can you guess her plan?)
"Oh no!" cried Mehar. "Didn't you know? Monkeys never take their hearts swimming! Chiku's heart is hanging in the jamun tree. Quick, swim back and we'll fetch it!"
Silly Magar believed her! He raced back, splash, splash, SPLASH. The moment they reached the bank, Mehar and Chiku jumped up, up, UP, to the very top of the tree.
"Where is the heart?" called Magar. Chiku laughed. "Right here inside me, where it always was! A friend who tricks a friend is no friend at all."
Magar hung his head. Mehar felt a little sorry for him. She lowered a basket of jamuns. "Take these to your wife instead. Sharing is sweeter than tricking."
Whoosh! Mehar was back in bed, her lips still a little purple. On the last page of the book was a new picture: a monkey and a crocodile, sharing a jar of jamun jam.

moral.en: When you are in trouble, stay calm and think: a clever idea can save you. And a true friend never tricks a friend.
moral.de: Wenn du in Not bist, bleib ruhig und denk nach. Und ein echter Freund trickst keinen Freund aus.
moral.hi: मुसीबत में घबराओ मत, सोचो। और सच्चा दोस्त कभी धोखा नहीं देता।
moral.hi_roman: Musibat mein ghabraao mat, socho. Aur sachcha dost kabhi dhokha nahin deta.

questions.en: Why did Magar stop in the middle of the river?
How did Mehar get them back to the tree?
What would you do if a friend tried to trick you?
